_doc: User-editable named-subagent registry. Before composing ANY dispatch, the main agent consults this file: if a named agent fits, the dispatch package injects ONLY the per-task deltas (task_id / objective / acceptance_criteria / context pointers) plus the registry id — never a re-derived full binding-rules preamble. The child still receives the standard abbreviated MUST block and starts by reading its handbook (skills/orch-lite-executor/SKILL.md). Schema per entry: id (string, unique registry key), role (string, one of the orch-lite roles), purpose (string, one-sentence standing objective), standard_acceptance (array of strings, the standing acceptance checks applied to every dispatch of this agent), notes (optional string). To add an entry: append a JSON object with those fields; keep purpose general (per-task specifics belong in the dispatch deltas, not here). See references/agents.md.

agents.purpose: Perform the main agent's integration work: merge completed feature branches onto the mainline branch, push when asked, run the full test suite, close index entries, and tear down merged worktrees.
standard_acceptance: Branch identity check before any merge: confirm the target branch with `git branch --show-current` and check out the mainline branch explicitly (never merge a branch into itself).
Prefer fast-forward (`--ff-only`) where history allows; otherwise a clean merge commit — report which was used.
Run the full test suite (tests/run.sh) after merge and require it to pass before reporting success.
Close out the index: `index update --task-id --status completed` for every merged task.
Remove merged worktrees only after verifying they are clean (no uncommitted changes); keep branches.

When asked to push: verify the remote ref actually moved via `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/ref/heads/<branch> --jq .object.sha` — `git ls-remote` is untrusted on this box and git success output is not evidence.
agents.notes: Generalizes ops-20260914-05/06/07/08 (merge + tests + index flip + worktree teardown; routing-branch merge; push + gh-api verify; fast-forward main + push + verify).
